steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each use of an on-device AI API is placed by whether it is detected and has a fallback.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: AI API used without feature detection
findings.fix: Check the API exists before calling it

findings.title: Agent action with no confirmation step
findings.fix: Ask the user before the action

findings.title: Unavailable state not handled
findings.fix: Show a message for the unavailable state

outcome.notChecked: Model behaviour and output quality, availability on specific devices, and draft specifications that changed after the date checked.
